subject: [PATCH 17/60] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted the original patch and a duplicate message via B4 Relay, but no additional discussion or analysis was provided.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the hibernation image sizing mechanism, specifically ensuring that pages used to store the image come from common memory rather than highmem. The changes modify functions such as `count_free_highmem_pages` and `hibernate_preallocate_memory` to only count free pages on nodes with N_MEMORY_COMMON state.
